prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Style/medium: believable candid editorial photography, natural skin and fabric texture, realistic anatomy. Soft daylight, warm approachable academic atmosphere, restrained blue and neutral accents.
Constraints: fictional adults and illustrative setting without identifiable institution. Full-frame standalone photograph edge to edge. No readable text, lettering, UI overlays, logos, watermark, borders or rounded corners.
Asset type: wide 16:9 workshop card photograph.
Primary request: adult Latin American university learner practicing programming on a laptop in a daylight study room.
Subject: dark-haired adult man with glasses and charcoal casual sweatshirt, in three-quarter side view, concentrating on laptop on desk. A few subtle colored code-like lines on screen, deliberately too small and defocused to read.
Composition: medium close view, learner left and laptop right, primary action within central horizontal band.
